textwithimage.text:
Based on TI AM243x for headless Applications with Real–time demand

The TQMa243xL Embedded Module, based on Texas Instruments' AM243x processor family, offers a versatile solution tailored for headless applications with real-time demands. This LGA module is designed to accommodate pin-compatible processors within a single module, providing flexibility for various applications.

Key features of the TQMa243xL include the powerful Cortex®-R5F architecture with up to 800MHz processing speed and integrated Cortex M4, making it well-suited for real-time applications. It boasts an impressive array of communication interfaces, including up to 4x Real-time GBit Ethernet interfaces with TSN support, up to 2x CAN-FD, and USB 2.0 connectivity.

Memory options include up to 256 MB NOR Flash, up to 64 GB eMMC, up to 2 GB SDRAM, and an EEPROM, ensuring ample storage resources. The module also offers a range of additional interfaces, such as UART, I2C, SPI, ADC, and PCIe.

With low typical power consumption of 1-2W and integrated security functions, the TQMa243xL prioritizes efficiency and data protection. It operates within standard and extended temperature ranges and is backed by a trusted partnership with Texas Instruments.

In a compact 38 x 38 mm form factor with an LGA 240-pin plug-in system, this module is well-suited for demanding industrial applications with real-time requirements. The TQMa243xL aims to provide embedded computing engineers with a reliable solution for headless applications with real-time demands.

text.text:
Features

  • Powerful Processing: Utilizes Cortex®-R5F architecture with processing speeds of up to 800MHz, supported by integrated Cortex M4, ideal for real-time computing tasks.
  • Extensive Communication: Offers up to 4x Real-time GBit Ethernet interfaces with TSN support, up to 2x CAN-FD, and USB 2.0 connectivity, ensuring seamless data exchange in embedded systems.
  • Versatile Memory: Provides options for up to 256 MB NOR Flash, up to 64 GB eMMC, up to 2 GB SDRAM, and an EEPROM, catering to various storage and data retention needs.
  • Robust Interface Selection: Features a wide range of interfaces, including UART, I2C, SPI, ADC, and PCIe, enhancing adaptability for diverse embedded applications.
  • Compact and Efficient Design: Operates with low typical power consumption (1-2W), is compatible with standard and extended temperature ranges, and boasts a compact 38 x 38 mm form factor with an LGA 240-pin plug-in system for easy integration into industrial environments
